test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Two statements, I and II have been given. These statements may be independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements may be the effect of the other statement.

Read both the statements and select the correct option.

I) Refreshing and delicious salads are full of antioxidants, Vitamin A, Vitamin C, folate, calcium, fibre and phytonutrients, which are good for health.

II) It is a perfect way to begin our day with salads in order to lead a healthy life.

options.text: I is the cause and II is its possible effect
Both I and II are independent causes
Both I and II are effects of independent causes
II is the cause and I is its possible effect

solution:
Given:

**Statement I: **Refreshing and delicious salads are full of antioxidants, Vitamin A, Vitamin C, folate, calcium, fibre and phytonutrients, which are good for health.

**Statement II: **It is a perfect way to begin our day with salads in order to lead a healthy life.

Since the nutrients in salads are beneficial for health, it logically follows that consuming them, especially at the start of the day, would promote a healthy lifestyle.

Hence, __**I is the cause and II is its possible effect.**__
